meta.title: Fleet Tenancy Hardening — Per-Step QA Contract
meta.description: The steal-plan's 7 steps, each with its exact QA scenarios and how they run. Prod-safety guardrails around a frozen droplet ingest contract.

props.title: Tenancy Hardening — How Each Step Gets Tested
props.subtitle: 35 scenarios across 7 steps, each tagged with exactly how it runs

props.content: Every step lands TDD-first: pin current behavior, write the failing contract test, implement, migrate module-by-module with the 909-suite green, then a hostile /ultraqa pass. The droplet that streams live collections into prod is unreachable — so its ingest contract is frozen and guarded on every step.

props.label: steps, each with its own QA matrix

props.title: The droplet contract is a frozen API
props.content: Live collections stream into prod from a droplet we cannot access. reportTelemetry / reportPosition / upsertBoat / activateFromBox signatures + the FLEET_DEVICE_TOKEN dual gate must not change. A droplet-simulator replay test is written before step 3 and stays green after every step.

props.title: We cannot break current prod locally
props.content: No deploy access to hearty-weasel-878. All TDD runs on convex-test (in-memory) + a personal convex dev deployment. Risk concentrates only at cutover deploy to the (not-yet-created) Argo Convex prod.

props.title: Env guard in every harness
props.content: Playwright e2e and /ultraqa hard-abort if the target Convex URL is prod. QA runs on local dev or pre-DNS staging only.

props.label: STEP 1
props.title: Roles-as-data RBAC
props.subtitle: permissions become seeded data, not a hardcoded enum

rows.sc: Parity sweep: new hasPermission verdict == old rank-enum verdict for every role × gated function — catches silent privilege widening
rows.how: table-driven golden test over ROLE_RANK × exported gated functions

rows.sc: Permission change without redeploy: revoke a grant mid-test → next call refused
rows.how: two-phase allow → data edit → deny, no code reload

rows.sc: Missing seed fails closed: role/permission row absent → deny, never 500, never allow
rows.how: delete seed row, assert clean refusal

rows.sc: Corrupt role string → treated as least-privilege
rows.how: insert bogus role='superuser' row, assert denial

rows.sc: RBAC tables self-protected: non-owner cannot write roles/role_permissions via any path
rows.how: enumerate mutations touching those tables, hostile-call as viewer/operator/admin

rows.sc: Full pairwise matrix: actor role × target role × action (remove/promote/demote) with golden verdicts — no gaps
Self-actions: self-demote, self-remove (leave org) per encoded rules
Last-owner invariant: sole owner can't be removed/demoted via any path; double-demotion race still leaves ≥1 owner
rows.how: both paths + sequential race; assert invariant after both

rows.sc: Cross-org actor: org-A admin acts on an org-B membership → forbidden
No duplicated rules remain outside the gate
rows.how: CI grep/lint fails on ROLE_RANK/hasRole usage outside lib + gate

rows.sc: Droplet frozen contract unchanged: dual gate; wrong/missing/stale token refused; correct replay accepted
FBC network boundary: franchisor grouping grants NO cross-org data reads
Org-farm probe: one identity mass-creates orgs, probes for quota/visibility leaks (TODO #45)

props.label: STEP 4 · is itself a QA deliverable
props.title: Tenancy e2e-by-feature suite
props.subtitle: the permanent home for the P1 + rebind regressions

rows.sc: Org-create: fresh Clerk user → Onboarding → self-create org → lands with owner role
Invite-before-signin rebind (P1 regression home): invite by email → first sign-in → pending:<email> rebinds → member sees org
Rebind hijack attempt: case-variant / plus-addressed email must NOT claim someone else's pending row
Role-change propagation: promote viewer→admin in one context; second context's nav updates reactively without reload
Anon boot: unauthenticated → AuthGate; network responses contain zero tenant rows
Two-org isolation: two contexts signed into different orgs; each screen shows only its own fleet

props.title: getOrgWorkspace single query

Anon / non-member → null, never partial data
Reactivity: role change → subscribed workspace updates → UI downgrades live
No over-fetch: field-level scan proves org-A workspace has zero org-B artifacts

props.title: TanStack Router (Router only, NOT Start)

PWA/offline regression (flagged port risk): offline boot + cached tiles still work after Router adoption
